payload.decision_consequence: Signal-only. Resolution does not authorize or size any trade and does not move any registered REGINALD threshold. This forecast is submitted at 10 percent, NOT at the 50 percent this row carried until 2026-08-27, and the re-mark was made deliberately in commit 3ae52ac59368a0a386fc4d578af4a929e73fa538 BEFORE authoring this file, because AmendForecast is outside Increment 2's perimeter and a probability submitted here cannot be corrected in-perimeter. Basis for 10 percent, all primary and previously graded: WAL is returning capital rather than raising it, having authorized a 150 million dollar H2 buyback alongside a loan-growth guide cut on its 2026-07-22 call; EGBN's CET1 rose 78 basis points to 14.58 percent with CRE concentration falling from 295.1 to 267.6 percent, back below the 300 percent supervisory line; two of the window's six months have elapsed with neither issuer raising; and the FDIC Q2 2026 Quarterly Banking Profile published 2026-08-25 shows industry CRE credit improving on every published measure with provision expense down 10.0 percent quarter over quarter, so the sector backdrop that would force a raise is easing rather than tightening. The residual is deliberately not zero and its path is named: an equity-funded acquisition, the regional consolidation wave being live, is the one route to a qualifying raise that does not require credit distress; WAL's pending 99 million dollar life-science appraisal is a smaller second path.
